show.description: In the bustling streets of Mumbai, a humble groundskeeper hides a supernatural cricket strike known as the Phantom Shot. When greed and ambition expose his gift, betrayal and rivalry turn his life into a battlefield. But in the end, true power lies not in the bat—but in the man who dares to wield it.
